contract.Screen rows: Actual Golden manager outliner rows show authored target/output, resolution and individual output API-accepted FPS. Narrow containers retain compact FPS and complete target/resolution/state in a tooltip. Wide containers show secondary columns. Runtime dimensions come from admitted native target metadata.
contract.Surface rows: Source media/channel names follow live rename/removal and remain available in narrow rows. Definitions stay real Parameters and selection/add/context/Inspector behavior remains Golden-owned.
contract.footer: Public app-neutral MainWindow footer snippet and actual MapGyver renderer submitted FPS, selected adapter, CPU submission duration and tracked allocation charges. Both footer and rows share exactly one window-owned recovering status subscription.
contract.bounds: One constant-size InspectRow request per mounted row, one in-flight and one coalesced latest request, session/project/disposal fences. Backend UUID lookup does not materialize Surface or channel collections. Existing bounded presentation-worker output metadata is sampled once a second; counters exclude busy/unavailable/failed deliveries and reset on device/endpoint incarnation. No per-frame engine polls or GPU queries.
